# SeekAPI — China procurement for AI agents and overseas buyers

SeekAPI is a China-side procurement desk. It helps find and screen China suppliers for a specified product, quantity and requirements. A successful China Supply Check returns three distinct evidence-backed China supplier candidates worth advancing to RFQ. Supplier RFQ-worthiness is separate from exact product qualification. Reports preserve observed price basis, MOQ fit, available identity evidence, source/time and field-specific unknowns; unsupported shortages are reported honestly.

Current public facts: https://seekapi.ai/.well-known/csc-commercial-truth.json
Current payment: x402 live, 2.99 USDC on Base for the text/model path. Public credit-card checkout is OFF and is not available to purchase. Free discovery and brief preparation use MCP. Bounded PNG reference-image preparation is available with no payment or Provider effect; public image purchase is OFF; free image preparation is available. Do not purchase on the assumption that an image-only request will run. The existing confirmed text/model purchase/run path is documented by live discovery. Status/result require independent signed-wallet authentication bound to the settled order. Supplier contact and RFQ execution are not included in the check.

## Continue after the shortlist
A buyer or Agent may request a separate human scope review for contacting selected suppliers, an authorized RFQ and real quote comparison, sample or production follow-up, procurement coordination and China-side export/logistics handoffs. SeekAPI can take on agreed tasks after scope, fee, recipient permissions and authority are confirmed. This is a manual request and acceptance path, not a live autonomous human-task API. The proposed USD 19.90 Live RFQ Compare package is not currently open for purchase; no fixed price is advertised for other scoped work.

Quantity-tier match is UNKNOWN without a recorded tier.
